overrides.timing_input: Use the public actual solver clock h.t at each sample, not the nominal n*dt grid. This is simulation time, not hidden teacher biological state. Apply an event iff h.t >= its scheduled timestamp, with no numerical tolerance. Do not infer event phase from biological states or outcomes.
overrides.decision: Same unchanged v1/v2 calibration and 12-cell confirmation numeric gates, both canonical mechanisms, and all three negative controls. An IV-C1 pass is limited to isolated deterministic one-release synapses under imposed voltage; it does not authorize Task33 without IV-C2 and IV-C3.
overrides.scope: Prospective new schedules test the clock/event-boundary hypothesis after v1/v2 and forensic schedules were opened. No release-RNG, plasticity, autonomous voltage, or multicompartmental claim.
